description: This file defines the ProductReviewEntity class, representing product reviews within the system, including properties like description, productId, date, and rating, and extending ShopEntity.

classes.name: ProductReviewEntity
classes.description: Entity class for product reviews, holding review details such as description, product ID, date, and rating, and implements Serializable.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with the review.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with the review.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Returns the rating given in the review.

methods.name: setRating
methods.description: Sets the rating for the review.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the review.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
